medida_nota_huella: A fingerprint is a set of reads that can recognize your computer without cookies: how it draws text, which graphics card it has, how it renders a sound, which fonts it has. Some websites make them for other reasons, such as drawing or games. ZERO does not change what they read: it only counts it. It looks at the main page, not the frames inside it, and the origin comes from the call stack, which the page itself can alter.
medida_nota_grabacion: A session recording service can keep what you do on the page (clicks, movements, what you type) to watch it later. ZERO sees where requests go, not what they carry: “after you typed” does not mean it took what you typed.
medida_nota_cifrado: ZERO recognizes the parameter’s name and the value’s shape (a SHA-256 or MD5 hash); it does not keep the value or know whose it is. Hashed does not mean anonymous: the same email always gives the same hash, and it can be used to recognize you.
medida_nota_subida: Counts the body of requests (what is sent besides the address). When the browser cannot read it, the request counts without a size. What travels in the address itself is not added.

esc_como_1: Identity: each computer has its own Curve25519 and Ed25519 keys; verification is the short code (SAS) you compare. Identity signatures are Ed25519: they are not post-quantum.
esc_como_2: Messages: Olm (vodozemac's double ratchet, Matrix's) and on top a hybrid ML-KEM-768 layer (FIPS 203) with ChaCha20-Poly1305, renewed every 50 messages or 10 minutes.
esc_como_3: Files in the conversation: XChaCha20-Poly1305 with a fresh key per file, in numbered blocks; the key travels inside Olm and the ML-KEM layer.
esc_como_4: Calls: WebRTC with DTLS-SRTP and Opus; what sets them up goes inside Olm. The audio encryption (DTLS) is not post-quantum.
esc_como_5: Delivery room: the 256-bit key travels only in the link; ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM channel, and each file with its own AES-256-GCM key (STREAM) and its hash tree (RFC 6962). No ML-KEM: the receiver's browser does not have it.
esc_como_6: Sizes: what goes between computers is padded to fixed sizes (Padmé), so the relay cannot tell the length of each message. It does not hide when you talk.
esc_como_7: On your disk: the key of your identity and those of the deliveries, sealed with DPAPI for your Windows account. On macOS, readable by your user only.
esc_como_8: GUARDIANA stores no IP addresses and reads nothing: the relay only passes encrypted bytes.

ent_como: Each file is sealed on your disk with its own AES-256-GCM key, in pieces of 1 MiB (STREAM). The link carries a 256-bit key your browser never sends; the receiver joins through the relay server with an ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM channel and, only after the right code, gets the keys. Each piece is verified on arrival and checked against the hash tree; a broken download resumes where it stopped. No IP address is stored.

sub_carta_oposicion_asunto: Objection to processing for advertising and request for erasure, GDPR articles 21 and 17 ({web})
sub_carta_habeas_asunto: Consulta y solicitud de supresión de mis datos personales, Ley 1581 de 2012 ({web})
sub_aj_subastas_explica: Blocks the page's own auction program (Prebid.js, Amazon's apstag, Google Ad Manager) and the syncing of your identifier between companies. If a page needs it, allow it for that site from the side summary. Auctions a site runs from its own servers can't be blocked from here.
sub_aj_gpc_explica: Tells every site you don't want your data sold or shared (the Sec-GPC: 1 header and navigator.globalPrivacyControl). It is legally binding in about 12 US states; elsewhere it is a request.
sub_aj_ruido: A different fingerprint on every site
sub_aj_ruido_explica: Other companies' scripts read slightly different canvas, audio and graphics card values on each site and in each session, so they can't link your visits. The page you open is never touched.
sub_aj_uniforme_explica: Every site sees the same common values: a standard screen size, 4 processors, 8 GB of memory, one language, no motion or light sensors, no battery and a generic graphics card. Some pages may look or work differently. What stays real: the time zone, the pixel ratio, the installed fonts and your IP address. Applies to tabs opened after you turn it on.
sub_aj_ubicacion: Location: without your permission, a site only learns your country or region from your IP address.
